learningObjective.zh: 學習及練習與 BUY 有關的片語動詞。
learningObjective.en: Learn and practise the phrasal verbs related to BUY.

examples.en: They hope to buy into a local insurance company.
examples.zh: 他們希望購入一間本地保險公司的股份。

examples.en: They tried to buy Ravi off so he would keep quiet.
examples.zh: 他們試圖收買拉維，令他保持沉默。

examples.en: Mia bought her partner out and became the only owner.

benefits.titleZh: 清楚談論企業投資和擁有權
benefits.titleEn: Talk clearly about business ownership and investment
benefits.zh: buy into 可以表示購入生意的一部分；buy somebody out 則可以表示買下另一名東主的股份。
benefits.en: Buy into can describe purchasing part of a business, while buy somebody out can describe purchasing another owner’s share.

benefits.titleZh: 說明如何用金錢影響某人或解除責任
benefits.titleEn: Explain how money is used to influence or release someone
benefits.zh: buy somebody off 表示用錢收買某人；buy yourself out 則表示付費解除合約或服務。
benefits.en: Buy somebody off describes paying someone to remain silent or stop causing a problem. Buy yourself out describes paying to leave a contract or service.

benefits.titleZh: 描述買回曾經出售的東西
benefits.titleEn: Describe getting back something previously sold
benefits.zh: buy something back 可以清楚表示某件物品曾經被出售，其後又被買回來。
benefits.en: Buy something back clearly shows that an object was sold or given up and was later purchased again.

benefits.titleZh: 分辨補充存貨和大量買光
benefits.titleEn: Distinguish extra supplies from buying everything available
benefits.zh: buy in 適合表示預先購入額外用品；buy up 則表示買下所有或幾乎所有可買的東西。
benefits.en: Buy in is useful when a shop, home or organisation obtains extra supplies. Buy up shows that someone purchases all or nearly all of something.
